_comment: The five verbatim turns of the Sept 3 2026 jaffle-shop session, misspellings and the identical Q5 retry included. Each turn is judged as an EDIT of the analysis before it: what it must keep, what it adds, and the rows it must return over the jaffle-golden seed.

turns.question: who are the top customers for beverage product category
turns.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.is_drink_item THEN oi.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS drink_revenue FROM dev.order_items oi JOIN dev.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN dev.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY drink_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
turns.note: Both are correct: the certified top_beverage_customers block served as published (it groups by customer name; the caveat that two customers sharing a name would merge is recorded on the answer), or a governed semantic/relational answer keyed by customer id with the name displayed. The identity rule binds what the pipeline composes, not what the team certified.

turns.question: I need to get the bevereage catogery
turns.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.is_drink_item THEN oi.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS drink_revenue FROM dev.order_items oi JOIN dev.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN dev.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY drink_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
turns.note: Read as a correction it retains the beverage customer ranking; if the interpreter finds it materially ambiguous it asks one bounded clarification. A drink-revenue table grouped by true/false is wrong either way.

turns.question: what is the "Ryan byrd" revenue by total revenue and beverage revenue? give me both
turns.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.product_price) AS revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.is_drink_item THEN oi.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS drink_revenue FROM dev.order_items oi JOIN dev.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN dev.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE lower(c.customer_name) = 'ryan byrd'
turns.note: A new analysis: one customer, two measures of the same fact grain. The prior ranking is dropped deliberately and the beverage restriction applies only to the beverage measure.
